name: MCP-Bench
description: MCP-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on realistic, multi-step tasks requiring tool use, cross-tool coordination, parameter control, and planning. It connects LLMs to 28 live MCP servers with 250 tools across diverse domains, testing abilities like tool retrieval from fuzzy instructions and multi-hop execution planning.
reputation: A new and emerging benchmark for tool-using LLMs that is not yet widely established but is relevant to the growing MCP ecosystem.
notes: Evaluates tool-level schema understanding, trajectory-level planning, and task completion; highlights persistent challenges for advanced LLMs
